title: PCEP: Add support for (parts of) draft-ietf-pce-multipath-12
description:
This adds support for:
* Multipath Capability TLV
  * https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-pce-multipath-12#section-5.1.1
* PATH-ATTRIB object
  * https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-pce-multipath-12#section-4.1
* Multipath Weight TLV 
  * https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-pce-multipath-12#section-4.3

There are a few more TLVs in that draft which are still missing.

commits_data.title: PCEP: Add support for Multipath Weight TLV
commits_data.message:
PCEP: Add support for Multipath Weight TLV

This is described in draft-ietf-pce-multipath-12.

See https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-pce-multipath-12#section-4.3

This TLV is part of the PATH-ATTRIB object.

Example output:
```
MULTIPATH-WEIGHT TLV
    Type: MULTIPATH-WEIGHT TLV (61)
    Length: 4
    Weight: 1
```

JSON format:
```
"MULTIPATH-WEIGHT TLV": {
  "pcep.tlv.type": "61",
  "pcep.tlv.length": "4",
  "pcep.tlv.multipath_weight": "1"
}
```

commits_data.title: PCEP: Add support for PATH-ATTRIB object
commits_data.message:
PCEP: Add support for PATH-ATTRIB object

This is described in draft-ietf-pce-multipath-12.

See https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-pce-multipath-12#section-4.1

Example output:
```
PATH-ATTRIB object
    Object Class: PATH-ATTRIB OBJECT (45)
    0001 .... = PATH ATTRIB Object-Type: 1
    .... 0000 = Object Header Flags: 0x0
        ...0 = Ignore (I): Not set
        ..0. = Processing-Rule (P): Not set
        00.. = Reserved Flags: Not set
    Object Length: 20
    Flags: 0x00000002, Operational (O): ACTIVE
        .... .... .... .... .... .... .... .010 = Operational (O): ACTIVE (2)
        .... .... .... .... .... .... .... 0... = Reverse (R): Not set
        0000 0000 0000 0000 0000 0000 0000 .... = Reserved: Not set
    Path ID: 0
```

JSON format:
```
"pcep.obj.path_attrib": {
  "pcep.object": "45",
  "pcep.obj.path_attrib.type": "1",
  "pcep.obj.hdr.flags": "0x00",
  "pcep.obj.hdr.flags_tree": {
    "pcep.obj.hdr.flags.i": "0",
    "pcep.obj.hdr.flags.p": "0",
    "pcep.obj.hdr.flags.reserved": "0"
  },
  "pcep.object_length": "20",
  "pcep.obj.path_attrib.flags": "0x00000002",
  "pcep.obj.path_attrib.flags_tree": {
    "pcep.obj.path_attrib.flags.operational": "2",
    "pcep.obj.path_attrib.flags.reverse": "0",
    "pcep.obj.path_attrib.flags.reserved": "0"
  },
  "pcep.obj.path_attrib.path_id": "0",
```

commits_data.title: PCEP: Add support for Multipath Capability TLV
commits_data.message:
PCEP: Add support for Multipath Capability TLV

This is described in draft-ietf-pce-multipath-12.

See https://datatracker.ietf.org/doc/html/draft-ietf-pce-multipath-12#section-5.1.1

The TLV is included in the PCEP OPEN object.

Example output:
```
MULTIPATH-CAP
    Type: MULTIPATH-CAP (60)
    Length: 4
    Number of Multipaths: 16
    Flags: 0x0001, MULTIPATH-WEIGHT TLV supported (W)
        .... .... .... ...1 = MULTIPATH-WEIGHT TLV supported (W): True
        .... .... .... ..0. = MULTIPATH-BACKUP TLV supported (B): False
        .... .... .... .0.. = MULTIPATH-OPPDIR-PATH TLV supported (O): False
        .... .... .... 0... = MULTIPATH-FORWARD-CLASS TLV supported (F): False
        .... .... ...0 .... = Composite Candidate Path supported (C): False
```

JSON format:
```
"MULTIPATH-CAP": {
  "pcep.tlv.type": "60",
  "pcep.tlv.length": "4",
  "pcep.multipath_cap.number_of_multipaths": "16",
  "pcep.multipath_cap.flags": "0x0001",
  "pcep.multipath_cap.flags_tree": {
    "pcep.multipath_cap.multipath_weight": "1",
    "pcep.multipath_cap.multipath_backup": "0",
    "pcep.multipath_cap.multipath_oppdir_path": "0",
    "pcep.multipath_cap.multipath_forward_class": "0",
    "pcep.multipath_cap.composite_candidate_class": "0"
  }
}
```
